effects.subject: THE 14 (a movement)
effects.text: rules of the 14: 1) stand still. 2) count to 14 out loud with everybody. 3) say 'that's the show.' 4) you are now a windmill. PIE is allowed after. first public 14: cafeteria, tuesday, lunch. be there. (it's not invisible this time) (it's the realest thing i've ever organized)
